name: TC-CDT-01: page heading is visible on Blog Article Detail
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/ContentDetailPages.cy.js#UtilityPages - ContentDetailPage [blogDetail] [en] — Blog Article Detail TC-CDT-01: page heading is visible on Blog Article Detail
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CDT-01
**Title:** Page heading is visible on Blog Article Detail
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Blog Article Detail page and verify its main heading is shown.

**Expected Result:**
The user sees the "ACE Pro EV vs Treo Zor vs Reep 3 Wheeler: Best Electric Cargo EV for Your Business" heading at the top of the page.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Blog Article Detail page
2. Verify the main page heading is visible
